`high-contrast.json`: contrast.css's palette, checked like any other (`npm run check:contrast -- --palette packages/theme/test/fixtures/high-contrast.json`).

`sehhaty.json` (not yet here): the six Sehhaty palettes, light and dark, projected on the nine `--tz-*`
colours (D10), in the shape of `sehhaty.example.json`. Reading the Sehhaty sources was not allowed from
this session: **the owner writes it, or gives the go-ahead to transcribe it** from
`sehhaty-dashboard/projects/ui-kit/src/lib/theme/brand-palettes.ts` and `_sehhaty-tokens.scss`.
